spec.name: Furniture Room Divider
spec.description: A freestanding two-panel bamboo divider with warm cream woven inserts, proud bamboo posts and four integrated crossfeet. Straight, connected construction fits within two blocks wide, with the front facing negative Z. Bamboo nodes, bindings and basket weave are painted details.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: two-panel bamboo room divider with woven cream inserts. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..32, y=0..32, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
